prompt: pulumi fully_qualified_stack_name diy backend org requirement
answer:
For a non-legacy, project-scoped DIY backend, `fullyQualifiedStackName` must use:

```text
organization/<project>/<stack>
```

The organization value is always the literal `organization`; it cannot be changed to your own organization name.

Example:

```ts
pulumi.automation.fullyQualifiedStackName(
  "organization",
  "my-project",
  "dev"
)
// organization/my-project/dev
```

Legacy DIY backends—local file, S3, and Azure Blob—support only the unqualified stack name. Project-scoped stack names are supported for new or upgraded DIY backends beginning with Pulumi v3.61.0.
